# Information security policy set

Outline of the policy set for the information security management system. Reviewed by the Head of Security.

## Information security policy

- Owner: Head of Security
- Review date: 2027-03-01
- Body: Staff and contractors of Example Ltd follow the information security policy; exceptions need written approval from the owner and are reviewed each year.
